verdict.rationale: Floot's homepage claims one-click publishing to a live shareable link. The custom-domain docs confirm apps are served from a *.floot.app subdomain by default, which supports a one-step publish to a live URL. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party docs on the publish/deploy flow beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the one-click publish works as claimed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can publish my app to a live URL in one step

citations.quote: Put your app online instantly with its own shareable link. Just one click “publish” and you're live.
served from your own address instead of its *.floot.app subdomain
Floot turns a plain-language description into a real, deployed full-stack app
